title: 第十四章 帮手
content_zh:
刚吃下去这颗丹药，李火旺就感觉到丹田如同有着一团火暖烘烘的，并且这团火有越烧越旺的趋势。
烧的他都顾不上内心涌出的恶心跟反胃。
“玄阳啊，回去歇着吧，这药效很烈，想要完全吸收要一阵子功夫呢。”
“是，师傅。”
跌跌撞撞回到自己住处的李火旺扶着门框大口的干呕起来，然而他却只能呕出一些清水。整个丹药早就已经完全吸收了。
“咔嚓咔嚓。”李火旺浑身的关节嘎吱作响，身体不由自主的抽搐着。
此时他丹田的那团火已经顺着脉络到了四肢。现在的他就像大夏天穿了一件大棉袄，浑身上下都仿佛煮熟了一样。
热量也让他的脑海昏昏沉沉的，李火旺躺在床上看着上方不断旋转的屋顶，想到刚刚发生的一切，想起料房内所有人的恐惧绝望的目光。
自己成为了丹阳子那令人作呕的帮凶，把对方对自己做的事情，强压在别人身上。
对方或许不识字，但是对方却并不愚蠢。在绝对的实力面前，自己做什么都是虚的。
“我一定要弄死他，必须想办法弄死他！！”李火旺在心中疯狂咆哮着。
他的右手不自觉的抓住了石床的边缘，随着最后一句话在心中喊出，他的手背上青筋暴起。
“咔嚓”一声，坚硬的石床被他生生掰下来一块。
这一变化让李火旺始料未及，他看了看自己的手，又看了看自己中抓住了石块。马上反应过来，这是丹药的作用。
不只是力量，其他方面也变的不一样了，李火旺甚至觉得自己的眼睛都能看的更远一点。那颗丹药让李火旺有种脱胎换骨的感觉。
可一想到这种能力是怎么换来的之后，李火旺心中再次泛恶心。
“李师兄？你没事吧？”白灵淼小心翼翼地从门口探出头来。
李火旺抬起头来表情复杂的看着她，一时间不知道该说什么。
白灵淼上前一步说道：“李师兄，其实你不用自责，我们都知道你身不由己的，如果……我是说师傅如果再让我去的话，你就别换别人了，反正.....大家的下场都一样。”
李火旺不想跟她聊这个，看着她流血的额头，掏出之前炼制的丹药递过去，“吃吧，能止血。”

白灵淼看到李火旺手中的丹药，却恐惧的用力摇了摇头。“我不吃丹药，绝对不吃丹药。”
李火旺干笑的几下，把那丹药随手扔在地上，“是啊，是药三分毒，吃了确实不好。”
白灵淼咬了咬嘴唇，思索一会后对着李火旺问道：“李师兄，你是想对付师傅吗？”
李火旺脸色一变，紧张的看向门口，连忙冲过去关好门。
“没事的，师傅现在听不见我们，师傅是靠“游老爷”来盯梢的。每次赶大集的日头，“游老爷”都要回去赶集。”
“游老爷是什么？”李火旺疑惑的问道，这是他第一次听到这个词。
“游老爷就是游老爷啊，它看不见摸不着的，我听我爷说过，只有有道行的高人能调令它们。”
“哦？”李火旺心中一动，把这个点记在心里，这个信息对自己非常关键。
“赶大集的时间是什么时候？”
听到这话，白灵淼疑惑的看着他，“初一十五赶大集啊，李师兄，你怎么连这都不知道？你爹娘没有带你去赶集吗？”
李火旺摇了摇头，他脑海中那些不知是真实还是虚幻的记忆，证明他之前只生活在城市里，从来没有参与过赶集这种乡下物质交流大会。
“李师兄，聊回正事吧，你真的是想对付师傅吗？”
李火旺表情一凝。“当然，我恨不得吃他的肉喝他的血！”
白灵淼深吸一口气用力点了点头，“那师兄，我算我一个吧，这种事情我也想帮忙！”
李火旺看向眼前的少女，还有她坚定的目光，白灵淼或许并没有他想象的那么柔弱。
“好，算你一个。”李火旺答应下来，自己现在确实需要帮手好。
仔细思索了一会后，李火旺表情凝重对着她说到：“我们两个人不够，你先去料房看着，找找有没有其他人心怀不满的。”
别的人或许不敢反抗丹阳子，可是料房里的药引注定要死了，其中肯定有不甘心的，这是根本性矛盾，这些人中肯定有自己争取的对象。
“嗯。”白灵淼点了点头，转身离开了。
李火旺坐了一会后，拿起绑在自己腰间的那块圆形玉佩，他想起了那位逃跑失败的师兄。

“玄阳啊，玄阳，当初你们这么一批人也是这样聚集起来的吗？但愿我不会落的跟你一样的下场吧。”
随后一段时间内，李火旺开始全身心地融入整个清风观，把料房被人整理得井井有条，无论是人还是物。
面对如此上道的弟子，丹阳子自然要有所赏赐，各种基本的丹药都告诉了他，仿佛真的把他当弟子来培养。
这些寻常的丹药效果不怎么样，最多让李火旺治疗点小伤寒跟外伤。
而且李火旺不知道是丹阳子丹药这样，还是这个世界的丹药都这样，丹药这种东西都有度的，吃多了，治病就会变成害人。
而且还有忌讳，不能混着吃，混着吃也容易吃出事来。
与其说李火旺现在可以成为一个蹩脚医生，倒不如说他现在是一位合格的下毒人。
丹药不是关键，关键的是李火旺在这接触中跟丹阳子的关系逐渐升温。
对方甚至有时候炼丹，还会让李火旺在一旁打下手。
当丹阳子再次把一位道童收为弟子，李火旺不再是最小的那位，已经彻底融入清风观当中去了。
通过如此近距离的接触，李火旺确定了自己猜想，丹阳子确实不认识字，并且还非常非常排斥别人认字。
他不允许自己的徒弟在任何事情上，超过自己，因此他找到徒弟基本上都不认识字。
这让李火旺感觉到一丝不对劲，他还记得当初丹阳子跟自己说过的话。
“因为成仙的办法是老君爷天书上写的，而且天书还是老君爷亲自送到我手上的，试问全天下还有谁能成仙？他说我能成仙。我肯定能成仙！”
既然他口中的老君爷给了他一本天书，其他徒弟都不认识字，他自己也不认识字，那到底是谁读给他听的呢？
content_en:
As soon as he took this elixir, Li Huowang felt as if there was a warm fire in his Dantian, and this fire had a tendency to burn stronger and stronger.
He was so feverish that he couldn't care less about the nausea and nausea welling up in his heart.
"Xuan Yang, go back and rest. This medicine is very powerful. It will take a while to fully absorb it."
"Yes, master."
Li Huowang stumbled back to his residence, holding on to the door frame and retching, but he could only vomit out some water. The entire elixir has already been completely absorbed.
"Crack, click, click." Li Huowang's joints creaked all over his body, and his body twitched involuntarily.
At this time, the fire in his Dantian had spread along his veins to his limbs. Now he looked like he was wearing a big cotton-padded jacket in the summer, and his whole body seemed to be cooked.
The heat also made his mind dizzy. Li Huowang lay on the bed and looked at the rotating roof above, thinking of everything that had just happened and the fearful and desperate eyes of everyone in the material room.
He became Danyangzi's disgusting accomplice, forcing others to do what they did to him.
The other person may not be able to read, but the other person is not stupid. In the face of absolute strength, everything you do is futile.
"I must kill him, I must find a way to kill him!!" Li Huowang roared crazily in his heart.
His right hand unconsciously grabbed the edge of the stone bed. As he shouted the last words in his heart, veins popped out on the back of his hand.
With a "click", he tore off a piece of the hard stone bed.
This change caught Li Huowang by surprise. He looked at his hands and then at the stone he had caught. I immediately realized that this was the effect of the elixir.
Not only the strength, but also other aspects had changed. Li Huowang even felt that his eyes could see further. That pill made Li Huowang feel like he was completely reborn.
But when he thought about how he got this ability, Li Huowang felt sick again.
"Senior Brother Li? Are you okay?" Bai Lingmiao cautiously poked her head out of the door.
Li Huowang raised his head and looked at her with a complicated expression, not knowing what to say for a moment.
Bai Lingmiao took a step forward and said, "Senior Brother Li, in fact, you don't have to blame yourself. We all know that you can't help it. If... I mean, if master lets me go again, don't let anyone else go. Anyway... everyone's fate will be the same."
Li Huowang didn't want to talk to her about this. He looked at her bleeding forehead, took out the elixir he had refined before and handed it over, "Take it, it will stop the bleeding."
When Bai Lingmiao saw the elixir in Li Huowang's hand, he shook his head in fear. "I don't take pills, I definitely won't take pills."
Li Huowang laughed a few times and threw the elixir on the ground. "Yes, it is a three-part poison. It is really not good to eat it."
Bai Lingmiao bit her lip, thought for a while and then asked Li Huowang: "Senior Brother Li, do you want to deal with the master?"
Li Huowang's expression changed, he looked at the door nervously, and rushed over to close the door.
"It's okay, master can't hear us now. Master relies on "Master You" to keep an eye on us. Every time there is a big market day, "Master You" has to go back to the market."
"What is Mr. You?" Li Huowang asked doubtfully. This was the first time he heard this word.
"Master You is Master You. They are invisible and intangible. I heard my father say that only a wise man can control them."
"Oh?" Li Huowang's heart moved and he kept this point in his heart. This information was very crucial to him.
"When is the time for the big market?"
Hearing this, Bai Lingmiao looked at him doubtfully, "There's a big market on the first and fifteenth day of the lunar month, Senior Brother Li, why don't you even know this? Didn't your parents take you to the market?"
Li Huowang shook his head. The memories in his mind, whether they were real or illusory, proved that he had only lived in the city before.The city has never participated in a material exchange meeting in the countryside such as going to the market.
"Senior Brother Li, let's get back to business. Do you really want to deal with Master?"
Li Huowang's expression condensed. "Of course, I can't wait to eat his flesh and drink his blood!"
Bai Lingmiao took a deep breath and nodded vigorously, "Senior brother, count me in. I also want to help with this kind of thing!"
Li Huowang looked at the girl in front of him and her firm gaze. Bai Lingmiao might not be as weak as he thought.
"Okay, I'll count you in." Li Huowang agreed. He really needs help now.
After thinking carefully for a while, Li Huowang said to her with a solemn expression: "The two of us are not enough. You first go to the cooking room and look for anyone else who is dissatisfied."
Others may not dare to resist Danyangzi, but the Yaoyin in the material room is destined to die, and there must be some who are unwilling to do so. This is a fundamental contradiction, and there must be someone among these people who they want to fight for.
"Yes." Bai Lingmiao nodded, turned and left.
After Li Huowang sat for a while, he picked up the round jade pendant tied around his waist. He thought of the senior brother who failed to escape.
"Xuan Yang, Xuanyang, did a group of you gather like this back then? I hope I won't end up like you."
Over a period of time, Li Huowang began to integrate himself wholeheartedly into the whole Qingfengguan, and kept the material room in order, whether it was people or things.
Faced with such a righteous disciple, Danyangzi naturally wanted to reward him. He told him all kinds of basic elixirs, as if he was really being trained as a disciple.
These ordinary elixirs are not very effective. At most, Li Huowang can treat minor typhoid fever and external injuries.
Moreover, Li Huowang didn't know whether it was Danyangzi elixir like this, or whether all elixirs in this world were like this. elixirs all have their own strength, and if you take too much of them, the cure will turn into harm.
And there are taboos, you can’t eat them together, as eating them together can easily lead to accidents.
Rather than saying that Li Huowang can become a bad doctor now, it is better to say that he is now a qualified poisoner.
The elixir is not the key, the key is that the relationship between Li Huowang and Danyangzi gradually warmed up during this contact.
Sometimes the opponent would even ask Li Huowang to help him when he was refining elixirs.
When Danyangzi once again accepted a Taoist boy as his disciple, Li Huowang was no longer the youngest, and had completely integrated into Qingfeng Temple.
Through such close contact, Li Huowang confirmed his suspicion that Danyangzi did not know how to read, and he was very, very resistant to others being able to read.
He did not allow his apprentices to surpass him in anything, so he found that most of his apprentices could not read.
This made Li Huowang feel something was wrong. He still remembered what Danyangzi had said to him.
"Because the way to become an immortal is written in the Heavenly Book of Master Lao Jun, and the Heavenly Book was delivered to me personally by Master Lao Jun. Who else in the world can become an immortal? He said that I can become an immortal. I will definitely become an immortal!"
Since the old master he said gave him a heavenly book, and none of the other disciples could read it, and he himself couldn't read it, then who read it to him?
